result.summary: The application layout is largely functional, but contains a significant alignment and text rendering issue in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The title 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is partially cut off or clipped by the image container in the 'Popular right now' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container height or the padding/margin of the title to ensure text is fully visible within the card area.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section has inconsistent spacing compared to the 'Fastest near you' cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the margins between sections and card borders to create a more polished, uniform user interface.
